I contacted the Council for suggestions and your name came up. Off the record: I'm glad these people aren't my headache.|Lieutenant Semphi Talen|<ref name="SWTORTalen" />}}
'''Semphi Talen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] with the [[police rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].<ref name="SWTORTalen" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="SWTORdate">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Talen was assigned to investigate a break in at the [[First Bank of Coruscant]]. The thieves were caught attempting to crack open a safety deposit box belonging to the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] noble [[House Ulgo|House]] of [[Ulgo]]. They claimed to be Ulgo cousins, trying to reclaim "valuable family heirlooms." The deposit box contained items smuggled from the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Talen assumed the Ulgos were planning to sell them on the black market to start raising more supporters for their cause. As Alderaan had seceding from the Republic, the case was a legal gray area. The [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] authorized for the safety deposit box to be placed in [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] custody and the matter turned over the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], much to the relief of Talen.<ref name="SWTORTalen" />

==Behind the scenes==
Semphi Talen was first mentioned in a message that is sent in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] (MMORPG) by [[BioWare]] released on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The message is sent to the Jedi [[The Barsen'thor|Consular]] class.
